summary.text: Bob Krist is the America First Party Nebraska candidate for Secretary of State. A retired Air Force lieutenant colonel, he served in the Nebraska Legislature from 2009 to 2019 and was the Democratic nominee for governor in 2018; he announced this candidacy on Aug. 31, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Served 21 years in the U.S. Air Force, retiring in 2000 as a lieutenant colonel, including service in Operations Desert Shield and Desert Storm.
Appointed to the Nebraska Legislature (District 10) in 2009, elected in 2010 and re-elected in 2014; chaired the Legislature's Executive Board.
